description:
Eva Victor had high praise for her "Behemoth!" co-star Pedro Pascal at the New York Film Festival premiere, calling him "so warm" and saying audiences will be excited to see his performance as a "very vulnerable, closed-off man."
 
"Behemoth!" stars Pascal as a cellist who returns to Los Angeles to compose film scores while confronting personal issues.
 
Pascal joined director Tony Gilroy and fellow cast members on the red carpet ahead of the film's December release.
